title: astrology solar-eclipse: the params of scene.play

x.description: Offset on the sky from the still body, east to the left.

y.description: Offset on the sky from the still body, north up.

on.description: When this step shows: 0.3 + 5.4 i / 14 for step i.

off.description: When the next step takes over (the last one: 6).

path.description: The Moon against the Sun in 14 steps, 2.6 hours either side of the peak, seen from the point of greatest eclipse when it has one. Scale: 0.5 over the Sun's angular radius.

moon_r.description: The Moon's radius, the Sun's being 0.5.
